registers.name: CTL
registers.note: the control register: ID6 HEX, ID5 NODEC, ID4 RUN, ID3 BANK, ID2-0 ADDR as latched by a MODE-high write; BLK = display blanked by a sequential update; ST = data-entry state (0 single digit, 1-8 the digit the next sequential write fills, 9 sequential update finished)

engineNeeds.need: run-time decode choice in the digits driver
engineNeeds.semantics: "decode": {"field": "CTL.HEX", "values": {"1": "hex", "0": "codeB"}}: the font follows the field's value; a value not listed uses the first entry. ICM7228A/B ID6 (CTL.HEX). The device now has decode hex only
engineNeeds.needed by: ICM7228A/B/C/D (and every chip with a selectable font)

engineNeeds.need: three-level input pin into a field
engineNeeds.semantics: pins.levels entry with "tristate": true: the field is 0 while the pin is driven low, 1 while it floats (Z), 2 while it is driven high. ICM7228C/D pin 9 HEXA/CODE B/SHUTDOWN: decode {"field": "SEL.MODE", "values": {"2": "hex", "1": "codeB", "0": "codeB"}} and shutdown "SEL.MODE=0". Pin 9 has no effect in the device now

engineNeeds.need: RAM bank select in the digits driver
engineNeeds.semantics: "bank": {"field": "CTL.BANK", "ram": {"1": [8 field names in scan order], "0": [8 field names]}}: the scan reads the array the field selects; the protocol writes each bank's registers with its own when CTL.BANK=v commands; the point and the No Decode byte are shared. ICM7228A/B ID3. The device now keeps one RAM; both banks alias it

engineNeeds.need: optional: point lit by a low bit (dpActive 0)
engineNeeds.semantics: "dpActive": 0 in digits: the decimal point pin (the 8th segment pin) is lit while its bit (dpBit decoded, segmentBits[7] raw) is 0. ICM7228 ID7 low lights the point. The device does it today by splitting every data write on ID7 (A/B 65 commands, C/D 16); with the key they would be 33 and 8

notes: Four devices (A, B, C, D), 18 parts. Bench: scratchpad/g2/icm7228_test.c (72 checks), add logic_test(icm7228_test) after display_out_test in backend/CMakeLists.txt; it loads the real library (parts ICM7228AIBIZ, BIBIZ, CIBIZ, DIPI). Goldens: parts.txt/traces.txt/footprints.txt need the 18 parts and 3 footprints added (listing_check, trace_check, footprint_check fail only with 'extra ... (not in the golden)'). The scratch copy's footprint ids PDIP-28-RENESAS-E28.6, CDIP-28-RENESAS-F28.6 and SOIC-28W-RENESAS-M28.3 may coincide with the ICM7218 agent's; keep one. All three datasheet ids point at the one Renesas URL (the sheet the maker still hosts is the 2015 text; it has no D). Not in any ordering table, taken from the task's DigiKey list: BIJI, CMJI883B, DMJI (package CERDIP and the military flag inferred from the suffix; BIJI = the B die in the A/C CERDIP). AIPIZ carries obsolete from DigiKey, not from the sheet. Assumptions: C/D digit address 000 = digit 1 (as A/B Table 4); repeated MODE-low writes after a single-digit control word go to the same digit; power-up state: A/B shut down until the first control word, C/D RAM 0.
